reply_text.comment: Thank you for reaching out about the SSL certificate issue. It appears that your certificate has expired, which is causing the error when accessing your dashboard. Please follow our SSL renewal procedures or contact your certificate provider to renew the certificate. If you need further assistance, let us know.
